title: A Tsar Made Men Pay Tax For Their Beards 🧔
caption:
This ruler taxed BEARDS 🧔
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In 1698 Peter the Great of Russia, wanting a more European look, put a tax on beards. Men who paid carried a beard token as proof. The tax was formally repealed in 1772.
How much would you pay to keep yours? 👇
first_comment: Imagine needing a permit for your face. How much is YOUR beard worth? 🧔👇
